authStrategy.description:

sameSiteCookiePolicy.description:

List of custom domains at which Frontegg services will be reachable. You must configure CNAME for each domain, you can
get record values from the portal.

fronteggDomain.description:
The domain at which the Frontegg API is served for this workspace. The domain must end with ".frontegg.com" or
".us.frontegg.com".

frontendStack.description: The frontend stack of the application associated with the worksapce.

magicCodeEmail.description: Configures the one time code email.

mfaAuthenticationApp.description: Configures the multi-factor authentication (MFA) via an authentication app.

mfaOtcEmail.description: Configures the account challenge with code email.

mfaRecoveryCodeEmail.description: Configures the MFA recovery code email.

newDeviceConnectedEmail.description: Configures the new device connected email.

newMfaMethodEmail.description: Configures the new MFA method email.

openSaasInstalled.description: Whether the application associated with the workspace has OpenSaaS installed.

removeMfaMethodEmail.description: Configures the remove MFA method email.

resetPhoneNumberEmail.description: Configures the reset phone number email.

smsAuthenticationEnabledEmail.description: Configures the SMS authentication enabled email.

ssoDomainPolicy.description: Configures how SSO domains are validated.

ssoMultiTenantPolicy.description: Configures how multiple tenants can claim the same SSO domain.

userUsedInvitationEmail.description: Configures the user used invitation email.

inputs.description: A collection of arguments for invoking getPermission.

outputs.description: A collection of values returned by getPermission.

id.description: The provider-assigned unique ID for this managed resource.
